After an extremely social and extremely fun wedding with friends I came back to some cozy gaming with the new update to Welcome to Elderfield So many great QoL improvements. I’ve made progress and I’m having so much fun. One of my biggest recommendations from this year.

items.context: This week hasn't even really started and I'm already exhausted from all the things and trying to find ways to cancel so i can just sit and hide with my book or my Stardew farm. Will I successfully cancel anything? No, but a girl can dream.
items.text: A book or a Stardew farm is a solid plan for hiding. Hope the week goes gentler than it looks right now.
